provenance.method: span-length-weighted mean open interval per parent section (docs/UCERF3-TD-AVAILABILITY.md §3/§6)
provenance.fetchedVia: GitHub contents API, pinned IP 140.82.112.5 + SNI api.github.com

notes: Rows carry a parentId that exists in exactly one fault model (alt-1 parents are FM3.1-only, alt-2/Santa Fe Springs FM3.2-only); every row maps to exactly one FM.
lastEventYear = 2013 - meanOpenIntervalYears; runtime elapsed = currentYear - lastEventYear (rolling, same convention as the Nankai BPT channel).
Parents absent here have no date-of-last-event constraint: UCERF3-TD treats them with the historic open interval (T_H = currentYear - 1875).
